# Vendored — do not edit here

This is a copy of `packages/ruflet_apple` from the Ruflet repository, placed
here because the template is fetched on its own and cannot reference a
package by a path on the machine that built it. The Dart dependencies in
`flet_packages/` are vendored for the same reason.

Change the engine in the Ruflet repository, then run:

```bash
ruby tools/sync_apple_engine.rb
```

Synced from ruflet_apple 2026-08-10.
